core_obligations: Compute the two complexes: write the local cohomology by the extended Cech complex of the ideal defining the closed subscheme, and use the description of derived completion to obtain the complex of ordinary completions of that Cech complex (proof lines 2344-2358)
Identify the derived limit: the transition maps between the truncated Cech complexes are surjective, so the derived limit is the ordinary limit and the first assertion follows (proof lines 2359-2364)

Read off the short exact sequences and the vanishing: breaking the derived limit gives the displayed sequences, and the consequent vanishing in negative degrees is the stated particular case (proof lines 2365-2366)
proof_roadmap: 由 local-cohomology-adjoint，RΓ_Z(M) 由扩张 Čech 复形计算；其 I-进导出完备化由该复形的各项取通常完备化的复形给出。
RΓ_Z(M/I^nM) 由同一形状的复形计算，且过渡映射是满射 ⇒ 由 compute-Rlim-modules 得 (1)：RΓ_Z(M)^ = R lim RΓ_Z(M/I^nM)。
(2) 由 More on Algebra 的 break-long-exact-sequence 引理给出上述短正合列；负次数上消失由极限项为空直接得到。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the derived I-adic completion of local cohomology with support in a closed subscheme with the derived limit of the local cohomology of the quotients by the powers of the ideal, and gives the short exact sequences computing its cohomology from the first derived limit and the limit (author lemma at source lines 2326-2341, label lemma-completion-local). The proof (source lines 2343-2367) writes the local cohomology as an extended Cech complex, uses the description of derived completion to replace it by the complex of ordinary completions, observes that the transition maps are surjective so that the derived limit is an ordinary limit, and breaks the derived limit into the displayed short exact sequences (proof lines 2359-2366). The comparison of the two complexes is the substance. H3.
